scientific_integrity: The general synchronization/activity theorem for arbitrary graphs is acknowledged as prior work. Claimed contribution is the full exact labeled recurrent period census, first-entry depth census and sharp uniform depth bound. Direct labeled-state checking is finite verification, not the basis for the all-size theorem.
scientific_limitations: Exactly three colors, synchronous threshold-one cyclic consumption, complete bipartite finite graph with nonempty parts, labeled configurations. No assertion about other dynamics or graph families. Unindexed equivalent results remain a literature risk.
title: Exact period-three and period-four attractor spectrum of three-color cyclic competition on complete bipartite graphs
